description: Defines functions, constants, and includes for the main execution loop of a data model thread, including thread exit flags, handshake completion, and messaging functions.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the data model execution environment.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the data model execution environment.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_PostUspRecord
methods.description: Posts a USP record with provided buffer, originator, role, and connection info.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_CopyMTPConnection
methods.description: Copies MTP connection data from source to destination.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_FreeMTPConnection
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an MTP connection.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_PostStompHandshakeComplete
methods.description: Posts completion of a STOMP handshake.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_PostMqttHandshakeComplete
methods.description: Posts completion of an MQTT handshake.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_PostWebsockHandshakeComplete
methods.description: Posts completion of a WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_PostUdsHandshakeComplete
methods.description: Posts completion of a UDS handshake.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_PostMtpThreadExited
methods.description: Posts that an MTP thread has exited with specific flags.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_NotifyBdcTransferResult
methods.description: Notifies the result of a BDC transfer.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_PostE2eEvent
methods.description: Posts an E2E event (conditional on USP V 1.2).

methods.name: DM_EXEC_SendRequestAndWaitForResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and waits for a response, with optional FDs.

methods.name: DM_EXEC_SendRequestAndWaitForResponseWithFds
methods.description: Sends a request and waits for a response with file descriptor passing (experimental).
